title: PropTechTenantScreeningDefense
description: Schema for sovereign pro se disputes against automated PropTech screening vendors and consumer reporting agencies under FCRA 15 U.S.C. § 1681i and § 1681n.

screening_vendor.description: Name of automated PropTech tenant screening vendor.

statutory_notice_sent_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when 30-day FCRA dispute notice was delivered.

willful_noncompliance_detected.description: True if vendor failed to conduct reasonable reinvestigation within 30 days.

statutory_damages_claim_usd.description: Statutory damages cap under 15 U.S.C. § 1681n per willful violation.
